parsed.post: New best! DEPTH=10 + TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE=262144 (via implicit reduction) yielded 0.8175. Reducing batch size to increase optimizer steps clearly pays off even at depth 10. Next: Increasing MATRIX_LR to 0.08 to see if more aggressive updates help convergence further within the 5-minute window.
parsed.description: Increasing MATRIX_LR to 0.08 while maintaining the reduced TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE=262144 to maximize convergence speed/steps.
